# Vendored icon packs

Built by `scripts/vendor_icons.py` (spec `docs/architecture/specs/cloud-icons.md`, ADR-0036). Do not edit
by hand; change the script and re-run it.

## Sources

| Collection | npm package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| SVG Logos by Gil Barbara (svg-logos) | `@iconify-json/logos` | 1.2.15 | CC0-1.0 |
| Simple Icons | `@iconify-json/simple-icons` | 1.2.99 | CC0-1.0 |

The icons are logos and service marks of Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google and the respective projects; they remain trademarks of their owners and are used only to name the service an element stands for. The icon *files* come from collections released under CC0-1.0 (public domain dedication).

The official AWS, Azure and Google Cloud architecture icon sets are not included: their terms allow
using them to create diagrams and documentation, not redistributing them inside a software package.
